title: Academic Writer — proofread pipeline changes contract
description: Shared handoff contract for proofread changes. The aw CLI emits and verifies change records; must-catch.py and apply-changes.py prepare and apply them, while build-tracked-docx.py renders tracked changes.

stage.description: Which pipeline stage produced this list. One list per stage per chunk.

chunk_id.description: Chunk identifier from chunk-article.py. Absent for whole-article stages (editorial).

summary.description: One-paragraph note from the agent: what it looked for and what it deliberately left alone.

change_id.description: Stable 12-hex hash over (stage, line, before). Assigned by the applying script, not by the agent; agents MAY omit it.

stage.description: Repeated on every change so a merged list stays attributable (drives the DOCX author name).

line.description: 1-based line number in PROOF_BASE, already offset-corrected for the chunk. Must be >= 1; a 0 is a contract violation, not 'unknown'.

occurrence.description: Optional. The 1-based position of this change's `before` span among ALL occurrences of that exact text on `line` (counted the way re.finditer/str.find would, left to right, non-overlapping). Set only when the finder already knows which instance it means and the line can carry more than one (e.g. a capped style-word rule flagging the Nth use past its cap while an earlier, still-allowed use shares the line). apply-changes.py uses it to target that exact instance instead of reporting skipReason="ambiguous-match"; absent, it falls back to the ordinary unique-match rule.

type.description: Mechanical stage uses typo/punctuation/typography/agreement/word; language uses collocation/register/syntax/tense/sentence/agreement/word; editorial uses cut/refocus/term-undefined/insider-reference/genre-fit/idea-flag.

before.description: Exact source substring to match. NFC-normalized on both sides before matching; never a whole-file fallback.

after.description: Replacement text, or null when the change is comment-only (every editorial change, and any language change with meaningRisk above low).

rationale.description: Why this is wrong, in the researcher's working language. Becomes the report row and the Word comment body.

meaningRisk.description: Risk that applying this alters the author's meaning, argument or voice. low → applied as a tracked change; medium/high → comment only, never applied. Editorial-stage findings are never applied at all, so they set 'high' by convention — the field is a not-auto-appliable marker there, not a graded judgement.

applied.description: Set by apply-changes.py, not by the agent. False with a skipReason when the change was not landed.

skipReason.description: Why a change was not applied.

refutedBy.description: Verify-lens keys that refuted this change (meaning-preserved / standard-Hebrew / voice-preserved). Present only for dropped changes; recorded, never silently discarded.

snippet.description: Editorial stage only: the passage the finding points at, when it is longer than `before`.

fixWith.description: Editorial stage only: what the researcher would have to do about it (not an automated edit).
